proposition: GET /offices: contract says 200 uses the selected office representation media type; implementation does write the selected formatter output without setting that formatter media type on the response.

target.direction: declared selected media type versus missing formatter response type

mandatory_search.reason: §11.4.1(a)-(c): media-type attribution requires independent documentation/test evidence.

manual_additions.reason: Crud route resolves offices/getAll; default response type application/json. No after-filter replaces media type.
Two separate classes implement same negotiated-format policy by selecting matching response Content-Type. CSV witness directly analogous to offices.
No office-specific response-header assertion or prose override found; README only describes data API.

decision.rationale: Office formatting changes the body but leaves the configured JSON content type. Independent controllers set media type for each selected format, supporting the contract policy. Missing response-type assignment is an implementation fault.
decision.details: Tool cannot parse Java @OpenApi source (exit 2, raw verdict NA). Manual controller+servlet route/config+formatter+tests+prose+independent controllers close retrieval gap. Result is static and limited to non-default selected representations. §10.7 JSON/plain-text mismatch rule is compatible with implementation attribution.
